identifier.value: Compliant Voice and Chat AI Agents

product.name: Compliant Voice and Chat AI Agents
product.description: AI agents that interact with customers via voice, email, and chat to automate verification, payments, account inquiries, and dispute handling while ensuring regulatory compliance.

identifier.value: Call Monitoring and Quality Assurance (QA) AI

product.name: Call Monitoring and Quality Assurance (QA) AI
product.description: AI-powered monitoring of customer support and sales communications to identify compliance issues, flag complaints, and improve agent productivity through real-time analysis.

product.name: Complaints Management and Tracking
product.description: A platform to monitor, categorize, and analyze customer complaints from internal and external sources to derive business insights and support product decisions.

product.name: Sales Communications Compliance Monitoring
product.description: AI-driven monitoring of sales communications across calls, emails, and chats to ensure adherence to company policies and regulatory guidelines in real-time.

product.name: Document Intelligence
product.description: AI-powered extraction and analysis of key information from various document formats to support loan file management and compliance workflows.
